answer: Latency-Bridged Pulse Ledger. Each identity must submit a periodic signed pulse tied to a unique hardware timing source; the wharf operator (relay hub) timestamps and cross-checks pulses against a shared clock bridge between hubs. Clones cannot forge distinct timing entropy without dedicated physical hardware, so each fake identity incurs the full device plus relay fee, paid before any reward vests. Marginal clone cost stays above expected payout permanently.
